findings.current: The instant my fist sank into that foul-smelling snout, I knew.
findings.defect: The opening impact sound is omitted, weakening the physical action that begins the chapter.
findings.rationale: 콰직 explicitly precedes and punctuates the punch.
findings.replacement:
Crack!

The instant my fist sank into that foul-smelling snout, I knew.
findings.source:
콰직!

악취 나는 주둥이에 주먹을 꽂는 순간 직감했다.

findings.current: *Throwing daggers. Is that what they call it in Murim—hidden-weapon arts?*
findings.defect: The draft broadens 비도술 from the specific art of throwing daggers to hidden-weapon arts generally.
findings.rationale: 비도술 specifically denotes a dagger-throwing or flying-dagger art, not the broader category of all hidden weapons.
findings.replacement: *Throwing daggers. Is that what they call it in Murim—flying-dagger arts?*

findings.current: “T-The captain fell in a single exchange… Who are you?”
findings.defect: The organizational title 조장 is rendered as “captain,” conflicting with the chapter’s established use of “Squad Leader” and obscuring the men’s hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 조장 means squad or team leader here, as confirmed when Hyuk Mujin addresses Taekyung by the same title later in the scene.
findings.replacement: “T-The squad leader fell in a single exchange… Who are you?”
findings.source: “조, 조장이 고작 일 합 만에…… 넌 누구냐?”

findings.current: “Why? Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi sounds wonderful. If you’ve earned that much martial fame before you’re twenty, you could stand to be a little prouder.”
findings.defect: “Before you’re twenty” introduces a stricter age claim than 약관, which refers to being around twenty or simply exceptionally young.
findings.rationale: 약관 does not establish that Taekyung is younger than twenty; the point is that he attained substantial martial fame while still very young.
findings.replacement: “Why? Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi sounds wonderful. If you’ve earned that much martial fame at such a young age, you could stand to be a little prouder.”
findings.source: “어머, 왜? 산서잠룡, 멋있잖아요. 약관에 그 정도 무명(武名)을 얻었으면 좀 더 자랑스러워해도 될 텐데.”

findings.defect: The subject is reversed. The narration sarcastically retracts the claim that Wolhwa understood Taekyung’s signal; it is not saying that Hyuk Mujin understood nothing.
findings.rationale: The preceding sentence says Wolhwa understood and nodded, and this line immediately undercuts that statement after she gives the opposite of the discreet answer Taekyung wanted.

findings.current: “Squad Leader—no, Young Master—is a direct descendant of the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Even if you were the most beautiful woman under heaven, you have no right to treat Young Master so casually. As a member of the family, I could not stand by and let it happen.”
findings.defect: “A member of the family” elevates Hyuk Mujin into the Jin blood family and loses his explicit subordinate-household status.
findings.rationale: 본가의 식솔 identifies Hyuk Mujin as one of the Jin Family household’s dependents or retainers, not as a member of its direct family line.
findings.replacement: “Squad Leader—no, Young Master—is a direct descendant of the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Even the most beautiful woman under heaven cannot treat the Young Master so casually. As a retainer of our family, I could not stand by and let it happen.”
findings.source: “조장, 아니 공자님은 태원진가의 직계이십니다. 설령 천하제일미(天下第一美)라 해도 공자님께 이리 소홀히 대할 수는 없는 법. 본가의 식솔로서 좌시할 수 없어 나선 것입니다.”

findings.current: “Come with me. To the Mount Heng Sword Sect.”
findings.defect: The draft turns Wolhwa’s inclusive proposal to travel together into a directive for Taekyung to accompany her.
findings.rationale: 같이 가요 proposes that they go together without making Wolhwa the principal traveler whom Taekyung must follow.
findings.replacement: “Let’s go together. To the Mount Heng Sword Sect.”

summary: The draft contains one subject reversal, several altered hierarchy or action details, and two localized omissions or terminology issues.
